bound_facts: Production Monitoring is advertised at USD 48 and inspection is advertised from USD 118, with higher sampling options.
Independent third-party providers include Bureau Veritas, CCIC and SGS.
Inspection can be attached to a Trade Assurance order; after payment the provider receives the task, buyer and seller are notified, onsite work occurs and the report is delivered within 24 hours.
Alibaba.com buyers outside mainland China can order the service and card payment is supported.
Verified Supplier uses independent third-party onsite verification by recognized inspection companies.
Detailed assessment reports and factory videos are surfaced to buyers.
Buyer-visible verification content is integrated into supplier discovery rather than requiring an independent router.
Alibaba exposes inspection-service providers directly through a searchable/contactable marketplace surface.
QIMA offers online booking, global inspection coverage and rapid reporting with a large field/lab workforce.
The incumbent demonstrates that off-platform independent inspection already has a standardized global service model.

contradiction_search: Current demand observations prove trust pressure but do not prove that generic local-inspector routing is unowned.
Alibaba already bundles low-cost inspection ordering, payment, provider dispatch, onsite execution and fast reporting into the purchase workflow.
Verified Supplier already brings third-party onsite trust evidence into supplier discovery.
QIMA demonstrates a standardized off-platform global inspection incumbent, so narrowing the thesis to off-Alibaba inspection does not establish a new unowned control edge.
No public evidence in this bounded preflight establishes repeatable buyer acquisition for a new neutral router without founder-by-founder Reddit/DM selling.
unresolved_but_not_promotable: A highly specialized vertical or geography-specific inspection service could have unmet demand, but that is a new narrower thesis and cannot be inferred from the broad generic router evidence.
Private pricing gaps or underserved off-platform buyers may exist, but they are not evidenced as a regenerative independently ownable control edge in this scan.
